entry.title: Course planning and LMS guide
entry.why: Connect course planning documents and evidence-based revisions.
entry.status: Authored starter; official platform references checked 2026-10-08. Live LMS authoring not tested.

briefing.purpose: Connect course planning documents and evidence-based revisions.
briefing.inputs: Learners, syllabus/objectives, modules, assessments and existing evaluation evidence.
briefing.approach: Link or create missing artifacts, map objective-to-assessment alignment and inspect the actual LMS before editing.
briefing.outputs: Connected course workspace and traceable improvement proposals.
briefing.requirements: Document tools; authorized LMS/browser access only when portal work is needed.
briefing.limits: Platform references do not prove local configuration; planned outcomes and observed results must stay distinct.
briefing.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.

use_cases.title: Check an existing course structure
use_cases.outcome: An inventory of actual course documents, learner routes and unresolved gaps.

links.why: Pair the reference with the course method when creating or revising linked planning documents.
